scope.name: Clothing Photo Intake
in_scope: add user-facing local image upload/intake in the live Fashion Design Engine and preserve source-image provenance without treating pixels as garment truth
detect or accept bounded garment regions/slices and visible-feature observations suitable for the existing FGA-05 clothing-reference proposal adapter
map visible garment evidence into review-required FGA-05 parameter proposals with confidence/uncertainty and explicit ambiguous/occluded handling
allow the user to accept, reject or correct reviewed proposals before applying them to the current FDE semantic draft
never invent hidden garment details, topology accommodation, equipment truth, anatomy or mechanics from the image
keep a provider-off deterministic intake path and expose optional-provider unavailability without blocking manual review/correction
focused cross-platform tests for upload/intake, region evidence, uncertainty, proposal review, correction and Studio application
out_of_scope: FDE-06 PAPT asset realization, generative garment synthesis or paid production execution
new garment semantics or a second clothing-reference authority
Mall, marketplace, commerce, public sharing or monetization
equipment ownership/stats, anatomy or mechanics mutation
